verdict: Knockout deck. The conspiracy roster is comprehensive and nearly every card lands a quotable persona-line - Mockingbird's 'suggest the emphasis,' Black Sheep Prince's 'Mummy paid the settlement,' Magic Bullet's 'I'm just a bug,' Demolition's 'physics took a day off.' The plumbing-as-cover-up metaphor unifies thirteen four-card packs without losing edge, and the RAF dice system stays consistent across every card. Density of references rewards conspiracy-literate audiences; a handful of cards (Moloch, Overton Window, Egregore) play more conceptually than embodied. Table-ready: Y.
blurb: A 52-card field guide to the basement of reality - performable archetypes from Venetian Lion to Singularity, Mockingbird to Magic Bullet. For players who think 'follow the money' is the only honest game in town.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: POWER, PLUMBING & PYRAMID PIMPS – Follow the Money to the Basement of Reality (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

Follow the money far enough and you end up in a basement nobody admits to owning, ankle-deep, paying to keep it flooded.

Here is how the plumbing actually works. A question gets inconvenient, so a magic bullet ends it and the file is closed before the echo fades. The press picks up the official cause of death and repeats it in one voice, because the same hand that owns the pipes owns the megaphone bolted above them. A director you will never see on camera turns a valve, and a war switches on, a currency turns over, a country gets renamed a threat. None of it hides. It runs under the floor you are standing on, and the rent you pay is the part of you that stopped looking down. The enemy here is not a villain twirling a moustache. It is an architecture, and architecture does not get embarrassed.

Social Story Wrestling, conspiracy edition: 52 cut-and-play cards where you stop reading about the racket and start working it like a wrench. You pick up an archetype, perform its claim with a plumber's straight face, and the table rules whether the pipe holds or bursts in your hands.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The Power, Plumbing & Pyramid Pimps Core Deck: 52 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring The Magic Bullet, The Mockingbird, and The Director.
- The Freestyle Rules: the complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, just storytelling, the RAF dice ([R][A][F]) printed on every card, and a table that decides whether the cover story you just performed survives being said out loud.
- The Thirteen-Pack Pipework: thirteen four-card mini-decks you can run alone or stack into the full pyramid, each stamped with its own warning label, from "Tinfoil is a great conductor" to "Move fast and break democracy" to "It's for your own safety" to "Ideas have teeth."

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this deck and you are not buying a static PDF. You are wiring into the Protopian Pipeline. Every future expansion and topic-specific deck in this cycle reaches you as a free update, because the basement keeps adding rooms and you should not have to pay twice to tour them.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because a racket you can name out loud is a racket losing pressure. Put the receipts in a player's hand and the silence stops being free.
Are you broke? Enter "0" and take it. Cut it, play it, point at the pipes in your own life.
Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and tightening the next mechanics.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
"Follow the money. It always runs downhill, and somebody owns the drain."
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
